name: morph_rollup
doc: Morph rollup target library (moved out of holon/gen/machine.py in I6). Builtins are call templates ($0.. are the compiled arguments, ${param:NAME:DEFAULT} a facts parameter); blocks are Bend text emitted in the record-library section when the facts declare the listed types; prelude blocks go into the prelude slot. Applies to every facts file in spec/M1/facts. Untrusted like the facts: G1 regenerates the model from it.
prelude:
def b_blob_count(xs: List<&2, Nat>) -> Nat:
  match xs:
    case Nil{}:
      0n
    case Con{+h, t}:
      ite(Nat, Nat.is_eq(h, 0n), 0n, 1n+b_blob_count(t))

record_blocks.bend:
def b_set_last_csr(es: List<&2, HEntry>, +r: Nat) -> List<&2, HEntry>:
  match es:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{e, t}:
      match e:
        case HEntry{ver, tot, n, hb, prev, post, lbn, csr, bvh, tag, bdo, bdf, bdn, bds}:
          match t:
            case Nil{}:
              [HEntry{ver, tot, n, hb, prev, post, lbn, r, bvh, tag, bdo, bdf, bdn, bds}]
            case Con{e2, t2}:
              Con{HEntry{ver, tot, n, hb, prev, post, lbn, csr, bvh, tag, bdo, bdf, bdn, bds}, b_set_last_csr(Con{e2, t2}, r)}

def b_tags_exact(es: List<&2, HEntry>) -> Bool:
  match es:
    case Nil{}:
      True{}
    case Con{e, t}:
      match e:
        case HEntry{ver, tot, n, hb, prev, post, lbn, csr, bvh, tag, bdo, bdf, bdn, bds}:
          Bool.and(eq_bool(Nat.is_eq(ver, 2n), Nat.is_eq(tag, 2n)), b_tags_exact(t))

def b_hdr_of(e: HEntry) -> List<&2, Nat>:
  match e:
    case HEntry{ver, tot, n, hb, prev, post, lbn, csr, bvh, tag, bdo, bdf, bdn, bds}:
      [ver, tot, n, hb, prev, post, lbn]
